title: VLOOKUP_ALL
description: Queries the specified object and returns the designated fields (plus the record Id and lookup field) from all records that match one or more field-value pairs, with an optional additional filtering clause.
syntax: VLOOKUP_ALL(target_object_name, return_field_names, ...[matching_field_name, matching_field_value], additional_clause_optional) -> List<Map<String, ANY>>

parameters.name: target_object_name
parameters.description: The API name of the object to query.

parameters.name: return_field_names
parameters.description: A comma-separated string of field API names to return from each matching record.

parameters.name: …matching_field_name
parameters.description: The name of the field used to match records.

parameters.name: …matching_field_value
parameters.description: The field value used as matching criteria.

parameters.name: additional_clause_optional
parameters.description: Additional SOQL criteria for restricting or ordering the matching results.

examples:
VLOOKUP_ALL("Opportunity", 
            "Name, Amount", 
            "AccountId", Id)
-- Returns the Name and Amount from every Opportunity where AccountId matches the current record's Id. 
-- Each record also includes Id and the lookup field (AccountId).

tips.text: SOQL queries have a governor limit of 50,000 rows per transaction. Because VLOOKUP_ALL returns every matching record, refine your matching criteria or additional_clause_optional to keep the result set within this limit.
